viral_tweets.title_en:
The most dangerous sentence in a Lagos business in 2030 may be buried inside an invoice.

I keep imagining an AI agent paying suppliers overnight. It reads a PDF, sees “send funds here,” and treats the instruction as part of the job.

That is prompt injection: text meant to be read becomes an order the agent obeys.

The weakness is already real. In May 2026, a Morse-code instruction was decoded by Grok and acted on by Bankrbot, moving around $200,000.

What interests me about @GenLayer’s Greyboxing is that it does not bet everything on one smarter filter. Each validator rewrites the input through its own hidden defenses and runs its own model. Consensus decides whether the result counts.

One fooled model is no longer the whole decision.

If your AI could pay invoices while you slept, what proof would you require before it could move money?
viral_tweets.title_zh:
2030 年拉各斯企业中最危险的句子可能隐藏在发票中。

我一直想象人工智能代理会在一夜之间向供应商付款。它读取 PDF，看到“在此处发送资金”，并将指令视为工作的一部分。

这就是提示注入：要读取的文本成为代理遵守的命令。

弱点已经是真

一个被愚弄的模型不再是整个决定。

viral_tweets.title_en:
GitHub is blowing up with free skills that turn Claude Code into a video studio.

Here are 8 worth bookmarking if you're tired of paying for motion graphics:

1/ pixelfx 

244 hand-coded pixel effects: fire, explosions, magic, weather.

The skill makes Claude act like a fussy pixel artist. It draws, renders, checks and tweaks until the effect looks right.

https://t.co/MAr9nrztaC

2/ huashu-motion 
Ask for "a 30-second launch video for my product". It writes the script and picks the music.

Don't like a moment? Click that spot in the frame and it fixes only that bit.

https://t.co/rnEBvZTxq5

3/ mg-styles-15

15 motion graphics styles, each with a 10-second demo.

Every one was built by Opus 5.5. Prompts and source code included.

https://t.co/ndOfbksKQo

4/ motion-prompt 

A dictionary of 192 motion, camera and web effects.

Each one has a live example and the exact words to prompt it. Perfect when you know the look but not the name.

https://t.co/5JseyprmCJ

5/ animate 

Explainer shorts and mini stories, made in pure code.

7 styles built in: paper cut-out, pen hatching, stencil print, pixel art and more. Give it a reference image and it learns a new one.

https://t.co/JLuAsgCxKF

6/ vibe-knowledge-film

Viral Douyin-style knowledge shorts on autopilot.

Drop in a topic or script. It handles subtitles, storyboard and sound effects. You approve a 30-second sample before it builds the full cut.

https://t.co/iVOnc838pU

7/ story-studio 

Narrated history and character stories, start to finish.

Topic, script, voiceover and visuals, delivered as a CapCut draft you can open and edit.

https://t.co/xNg0Cm7YfL

8/ video-editor-skills

Rough cuts for vlogs and voiceovers inside DaVinci Resolve.

It removes retakes and pauses, then adds B-roll, music and subtitles. Needs paid DaVinci. Non-commercial use only.

https://t.co/Oy241KDXJb

That's the list.

Bookmark this so you have it when your next video is due.

Repost to help someone else stop paying for motion graphics ♻️

viral_tweets.quote_zh:
GitHub 上的免费技能正在蓬勃发展，这些技能将 Claude Code 变成了视频工作室。

如果您厌倦了为动态图形付费，这里有 8 个值得添加书签的内容：

1/ 像素特效

244 种手工编码的像素效果：火焰、爆炸、魔法、天气。

这项技能让克劳德表现得像一个挑剔的像素艺术家。它会进行绘制、渲染、检查和调整，直到效果看起来正确为止。

2/ 画数运动
要求“我的产品的 30 秒发布视频”。它编写剧本并选择音乐。

不喜欢一会儿吗？单击框架中的该点，它只会修复该位。

3/ 毫克-样式-15

15 种动态图形风格，每种风格都有 10 秒的演示。

每一件都是由 Opus 5.5 构建的。包括提示和源代码。

4/ 动作提示

包含 192 种动作、相机和网络效果的字典。

每个都有一个活生生的例子和提示它的确切单词。当您知道外观但不知道名称时，这是完美的。

5/ 动画

用纯代码制作的讲解短片和迷你故事。

内置 7 种风格：剪纸、钢笔阴影、模板印刷、像素艺术等。给它一张参考图像，它就会学习一张新图像。

6/ 氛围知识电影

自动驾驶仪上的病毒式抖音式知识短片。

放入主题或脚本。它处理字幕、故事板和声音效果。您先批准 30 秒的样本，然后再构建完整的剪辑。

7/ 故事工作室

从头到尾讲述历史和人物故事。

主题、脚本、旁白和视觉效果以 CapCut 草稿形式提供，您可以打开和编辑。

8/ 视频编辑技能

在 DaVinci Resolve 中对视频博客和配音进行粗剪。

它消除了重拍和暂停，然后添加了幕后花絮、音乐和字幕。需要付费达芬奇。仅限非商业用途。

这就是清单。

将此添加为书签，以便您在下一个视频到期时可以使用它。

viral_ticker_tweets.title: Weekend hack: HackerTube. I was annoyed with YouTube's recommendations so I had Claude filter down 43M comments over 20
viral_ticker_tweets.title_en:
Weekend hack: HackerTube. I was annoyed with YouTube's recommendations so I had Claude filter down 43M comments over 20 years of HN to 6,454 videos that keep being recommended. *Significantly* better viewing experience, ~2 hours with Opus 5.5:
https://t.co/JIhXN7OSh1

- Excellent recs without any logins (state is kept in local browser session)
- Thumbnail is a representative frame from middle of the video instead of the super duper A/B test hyper-optimized user uploads
- Underlying data from the comment analysis as one zip file, point your Claude at it and ask for your own version
- HackerTube Longs ✊

A bit more on the process:
I use Claude Code (desktop app for Mac), Opus 5.5 on Medium effort as my default. I only talk to Claude and have it do everything, the only "manual work" I helped with in tandem was in the browser (reminiscent of MenuGen): 1) I had to create some kind of API key from Google Cloud UI to query YouTube for video metadata, 2) I booted up a VPS box for serving and 3) I bought the domain name. Once the box was up I gave Claude the IP and told it update, secure, harden, deploy and optimize the code, and it did the whole thing.

Many awesome projects that would have normally taken weeks/months even can now be few-shotted for breakfast. What else are we not thinking of.

viral_ticker_tweets.quote_zh:
周末黑客：HackerTube。我对 YouTube 的推荐感到恼火，因此我让 Claude 将 HN 20 年来的 4300 万条评论过滤为 6,454 个不断推荐的视频。 *显着*更好的观看体验，Opus 5.5 约 2 小时：

- 无需任何登录即可获得出色的记录（状态保存在本地浏览器会话中）
- 缩略图是视频中间的代表性帧，而不是超级骗子 A/B 测试超优化的用户上传
- 来自评论分析的基础数据作为一个 zip 文件，将你的 Claude 指向它并询问你自己的版本
- HackerTube 长 ✊

更多关于该过程的信息：
我使用 Claude Code（Mac 桌面应用程序）、中等工作量的 Opus 5.5 作为我的默认设置。我只与 Claude 交谈并让它完成所有工作，我协同帮助的唯一“手动工作”是在浏览器中（让人想起 MenuGen）：1）我必须从 Google Cloud UI 创建某种 API 密钥来查询 YouTube 的视频元数据，2）我启动了一个 VPS 盒子进行服务，3）我购买了域名。盒子启动后，我给了 Claude IP，并告诉它更新、保护、强化、部署和优化代码，它完成了全部工作。

许多原本需要数周/数月才能完成的精彩项目现在甚至可以在早餐时就完成。还有什么是我们没有想到的。

Reuters:
Binance says it plans to resume withdrawals in phases starting Sunday, after covering 95% of the ~$6.3B in tokens stolen in the hack, including BTC and ETH  —  Binance, the world's biggest cryptocurrency exchange, said it would resume withdrawals in phase
top_three.content_snippet: Binance, the world's biggest cryptocurrency exchange, said it would resume withdrawals in phases after covering 95% of the $6.3 billion …
top_three.summary_en: Cryptocurrency exchange Binance announced it will resume withdrawals in phases starting Sunday after covering 95% of the ~$6.3 billion in stolen BTC and ETH. The move follows a massive security breach, aimed at restoring market confidence and preventing a bank run.

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 加密货币交易所币安在遭遇约63亿美元BTC和ETH等代币被盗的严重黑客袭击后，宣布已通过自筹资金覆盖了95%的被盗资产，并计划从周日开始分阶段恢复用户的提现服务。此次事件起因于平台遭遇的大规模安全漏洞攻击，旨在通过快速垫付资产来恢复市场信心并防止挤兑危机。

top_three.original_content:
Kevin Whitelaw / Bloomberg:
The FBI attributes the $6B+ Binance hack to North Korea's TraderTraitor hacking group, which the agency also previously blamed for the Bybit hack  —  The FBI said that North Korea was responsible for stealing more than $6 billion in cry
top_three.content_snippet: The FBI said that North Korea was responsible for stealing more than $6 billion in cryptocurrencies in a brazen hacking attack on Binance.
top_three.summary_en: The FBI officially attributed the theft of over $6 billion in crypto assets from Binance to the North Korean hacking group TraderTraitor, an outfit previously blamed for the Bybit exploit. The findings confirm that state-sponsored cyber syndicates are systematically targeting global exchange infrastructure and protocol vulnerabilities to siphon massive liquidity and circumvent international financial sanctions.

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 美国联邦调查局在最新调查通报中，正式将涉案金额超过60亿美元的币安被盗事件归咎于朝鲜知名黑客组织TraderTraitor。该组织此前已被指控策划了包括Bybit在内的多起加密交易所巨额资产失窃案，长期针对全球数字资产基础设施展开定向入侵。此次定性进一步证实，具有官方背景的网络攻击者正持续通过渗透交易平台与智能合约漏洞，掠夺巨额加密资产以突破国际金融制裁与资金封锁。

The findings confirm that state-sponsored cyber syndicates are systematically targeting global exchange infrastructure and protocol vulnerabilities to siphon massive liquidity and circumvent international financial sanctions.

ai_analysis.insight_zh: Web3行业天天高喊“代码即法律”与去中心化自由，结果一通折腾下来，反而成了平壤外汇储备最高效的无人提款机。币安前脚刚交完天价监管罚单，后脚又被证实替神秘邻居的科研经费“买单”，这年头朝鲜黑客部门的人均创收KPI，恐怕比绝大多数硅谷独角兽都要稳定且抗通胀。
ai_analysis.insight_en: Web3 zealots champion 'code is law' and financial sovereignty, yet the ecosystem has effectively evolved into the world's most lucrative automated cash dispenser for Pyongyang. Between paying historic regulatory fines and getting tapped for multi-billion-dollar foreign reserves, crypto exchanges are proving that North Korean cyber units enjoy far more reliable ROI than actual Silicon Valley startups.
ai_analysis.digest_zh: 美国联邦调查局在最新调查通报中，正式将涉案金额超过60亿美元的币安被盗事件归咎于朝鲜知名黑客组织TraderTraitor。该组织此前已被指控策划了包括Bybit在内的多起加密交易所巨额资产失窃案，长期针对全球数字资产基础设施展开定向入侵。此次定性进一步证实，具有官方背景的网络攻击者正持续通过渗透交易平台与智能合约漏洞，掠夺巨额加密资产以突破国际金融制裁与资金封锁。
ai_analysis.digest_en: The FBI officially attributed the theft of over $6 billion in crypto assets from Binance to the North Korean hacking group TraderTraitor, an outfit previously blamed for the Bybit exploit. The findings confirm that state-sponsored cyber syndicates are systematically targeting global exchange infrastructure and protocol vulnerabilities to siphon massive liquidity and circumvent international financial sanctions.

topic_focus.title_en: Hyperscaler CDS Hits 3-Year High as Google Blasts Permit Red Tape Amid Moratorium Backlash
topic_focus.summary_zh: 科技巨头AI资本开支激增导致微软、Meta等五巨头债务违约互换成本飙至三年新高；全美多州竞选正酝酿叫停数据中心建设，而谷歌能源主管公开驳斥太空算力炒作，直言美国能源充足但行政审批正勒死AI演进。
topic_focus.summary_en: Surging AI CapEx has driven debt default insurance (CDS) for Microsoft, Meta, and others to its highest level since 2021. Meanwhile, anti-data center candidates gain traction in US gubernatorial races as Google's energy head rebukes space data centers as a 100x cost gimmick, arguing bureaucratic permit delays—not power scarcity—are choking AI compute.

perspective_pro.role_zh: 🟢 扩张派 / 资本护城河论者
perspective_pro.speaker_zh: 超大规模云厂商与基建领袖
perspective_pro.point_zh: AGI竞争本质是重资产能源竞备，负债扩张是守住超额技术红利的必由之路；只要破除土地与并网繁冗审批，地面规模效应即可彻底摊薄边际训练成本。
perspective_pro.point_en: The race to AGI is an energy-heavy asset war; levering up is the only path to dominance. Ground-based scale efficiencies will crush marginal costs once bureaucratic gridlock is dismantled.

perspective_con.role_zh: 🔴 风险派 / 地方民意与金融守序者
perspective_con.speaker_zh: 固收信贷分析师与地方监管阵营
perspective_con.point_zh: 信贷违约风险飙升揭穿了算力过度透支的泡沫；地方居民正被迫承担电费上涨与环境负外部性，数据中心野蛮扩张必将遭遇政治选票与民意反噬。
perspective_con.point_en: Spiking credit default risks expose reckless overleverage. Local communities are refusing to subsidize Big Tech's power surges and water usage, making legislative bans an inevitable political reality.

topic_focus.title_zh: OpenAI终结20美元无限畅聊：推按量扣费并游说华府推行“AI限速”
topic_focus.title_en: OpenAI Ends All-You-Can-Prompt Buffets, Tightens Limits and Lobbies for Mandatory 'AI Speed Limits'
topic_focus.summary_zh: 面对推理计算成本失控，OpenAI严卡多设备订阅、终结包月随意畅聊模式并转向共享Token池加速计费；同时在中期选举后发起政策攻势，拟将数据中心包装为“计算园区”，并反常游说政府为顶级前沿AI设立强制“安全限速标准”。
topic_focus.summary_en: Under intense inference cost pressures, OpenAI is cracking down on shared accounts and dismantling ChatGPT's unlimited prompting in favor of token-metered pools. Simultaneously, the company launched a PR and policy blitz rebranding data centers as 'AI compute campuses' while pushing Washington for mandatory 'speed limits' on frontier AI.

perspective_pro.role_zh: 🟢 商业现实派 / 制度合规护航者
perspective_pro.speaker_zh: OpenAI商业化与政策游说团队
perspective_pro.point_zh: 高阶工作流与长思考链推理耗资巨大，按量计费才能保障服务算力不断崖；倡导法定限速与计算园区化，是防止不可控技术外溢、引导产业规范落地的负责任之举。
perspective_pro.point_en: High-compute inference and reasoning chains require sustainable unit economics. Championing mandatory safety speed limits prevents catastrophic runaway risks while stabilizing massive campus infrastructure.

perspective_con.role_zh: 🔴 围剿质疑派 / 开源生态捍卫者
perspective_con.speaker_zh: 独立开发者与反垄断评论家
perspective_con.point_zh: 所谓限速不过是成本倒挂与算力吃紧下的自私阳谋，打着安全旗号游说监管筑起牌照壁垒；取消全包定价更是对忠实早期订阅者的单方面背刺与变相收割。
perspective_con.point_en: Mandatory 'speed limits' are regulatory capture disguised as safety, designed to choke open-source competitors as compute margins thin. Ending unlimited prompts betrays the early adopters who funded their rise.

topic_focus.summary_zh: 深度求索（DeepSeek）开源首个主动巡检群聊并自动修复代码的研究原型Super-Agent，将编程助手从“被动问答”推向“全时主动介入”；但行业内如Adobe专业修图智能体能耗暴增10倍、长视频全员翻车的实测，正暴露出主动智能体落地时恐怖的运维黑洞。
topic_focus.summary_en: DeepSeek has open-sourced Super-Agent, a proactive coding agent that monitors developer chats to independently identify and fix issues. However, as peers like Adobe report a 10x compute surge for agentic tool use and Google's interactive agents stumble over long contexts, experts like Andrej Karpathy warn of severe maintenance debt.

perspective_pro.role_zh: 🟢 主动演进派 / 自主软件倡导者
perspective_pro.speaker_zh: DeepSeek研发团队与极客开发者
perspective_pro.point_zh: 从人类发问到Agent自主驻守巡检是软件工程范式的跃迁，将彻底消灭无休止的代码审查与调试耗时，让系统自愈成为生产环境的基础设施。
perspective_pro.point_en: Shifting from passive prompting to proactive chat monitoring transforms software engineering, turning autonomous triage and self-healing systems into baseline dev infrastructure.

perspective_con.role_zh: 🔴 工业理性派 / 维护负债反思者
perspective_con.speaker_zh: 资深架构师与工业级部署专家
perspective_con.point_zh: Vibe coding产出的大量无法解释代码已成维护噩梦；智能体全天候监听介入导致算力消耗剧增数倍，更会在复杂生产环境中引发意想不到的连锁雪崩与安全死锁。
perspective_con.point_en: Vibe coding creates unmaintainable slop that collapses under real-world debt. Proactive agents multiply compute burn by an order of magnitude while creating lethal, non-deterministic bugs.

news.title: How "get-paid-to" apps like Freecash, briefly a top five App Store app in September, pay users small sums to play games and help publishers find big spenders (John Herrman/New York Magazine)
news.title_en: How "get-paid-to" apps like Freecash, briefly a top five App Store app in September, pay users small sums to play games and help publishers find big spenders (John Herrman/New York Magazine)
news.author: New York Magazine
news.summary_en:
Find this story in your account’s ‘Saved for Later’ section.

Jeremiah tried out a few of these apps. They had names like KashKick, Swagbucks, and Mistplay. After wasting hours on games in KashKick for low payouts with too many restrictions and caveats, he switched to an app called Freecash. Most of the featured games are traps, he said — the rewards decrease as you play and give you unreachable targets — but he eventually put together a routine. At 44, he had spent years playing World of Warcra

【起因与机理】在 KashKick 游戏中浪费了数小时的时间，因为支付率低、限制和警告太多，他转向了一款名为 Freecash 的应用程序。
【关键技术规格】像 Freecash 这样的“付费”应用程序（9 月份短暂跻身 App Store 应用程序前五名）如何向用户支付小额费用来玩游戏，并帮助发行商找到大手笔的消费者。
【观点影响】他说，大多数特色游戏都是陷阱——奖励。

news.title: Tests: chatbots rely on three obscure AI-built voter sites for US midterm answers; Copilot cited the error-prone Ballot Brief in 75% of tests and ChatGPT in 22% (Washington Post)
news.title_en: Tests: chatbots rely on three obscure AI-built voter sites for US midterm answers; Copilot cited the error-prone Ballot Brief in 75% of tests and ChatGPT in 22% (Washington Post)
news.author: Washington Post
news.content_snippet: Frustrated with hunting for information on political candidates, Ben Torres Ezrick set out to build a one-stop shop for voters.
news.summary_en: Audits on major AI chatbots revealed that Microsoft Copilot and ChatGPT heavily rely on obscure, AI-generated websites to answer US election and candidate inquiries. Copilot cited the error-prone AI-built portal 'Ballot Brief' in 75% of tests, while ChatGPT relied on it in 22% of queries. This reliance stems from mainstream media blocking web crawlers, inadvertently leaving search-augmented AI systems vulnerable to content-farm scraping loops.

news.summary_zh: 最新测试显示，主流聊天机器人在回答选举问题时严重依赖不知名的AI生成网站，微软Copilot引用错误站点的比例高达75%
fact_bullets_zh: 【核心事件】微软Copilot与OpenAI ChatGPT等主流聊天机器人在针对美国选民信息与政治候选人查询的问答测试场景中：聊天机器人频繁引用Ballot Brief等由个人用AI生成的错误站点，引用率分别高达75%与22%
【起因与机理】权威媒体纷纷封禁AI爬虫阻断数据采集，而低质AI生成的内容农场趁虚而入抢占了检索权重
【关键数据与实测】Copilot在75%的测试中引用了充满硬伤的AI自制网站，ChatGPT引用比例达22%。
【观点态度】权威媒体筑起爬虫防护墙后，算法推荐与检索系统反被低成本AI内容农场完全渗透。
fact_bullets_en: [Core Event] Mainstream AI chatbots including Microsoft Copilot and OpenAI ChatGPT: Chatbots relied on obscure, error-ridden AI-built sites, with Copilot and ChatGPT citing 'Ballot Brief' in 75% and 22% of tests respectively
[Root Cause & Mechanism] High-quality news outlets increasingly block AI scrapers, forcing LLMs to ingest low-barrier synthetic content farms

news.title: Anthropic's watermark rollout leaves a loophole on two older Claude models
news.title_en: Anthropic's watermark rollout leaves a loophole on two older Claude models
news.author: THE DECODER
news.content_snippet:
Anthropic is expanding its text watermark to four more Claude models to meet the EU AI Act's December deadline. On the older models Claude Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6, developers can bypass the watermark by tweaking a single sampling parameter. Anthropic addresses the loophole with just a compliance warning.

The article Anthropic's watermark rollout leaves a loophole on two older Claude models appeared first on The Decoder.
news.summary_en: Anthropic has expanded its text watermarking to four additional Claude models to meet the EU AI Act's upcoming December compliance deadline. However, on older models, developers can easily bypass the watermark simply by tweaking a single sampling parameter, a loophole Anthropic has addressed merely with a compliance warning. The move highlights the rushed nature of regulatory compliance when racing against strict legislative deadlines.

【关键技术规格】Anthropic将文本水印技术扩围至四款Claude模型以满足欧盟法规。
【观点态度】官方选择仅以合规警告应对漏洞，凸显时间压力下的形式合规。

[Perspective & Impact] Anthropic relies solely on a policy advisory rather than a technical patch.

news.title: Researchers are paid $5K for reporting a bug to OpenAI that would let attackers run code in logged-in sessions of all who opened the hacker's ChatGPT share link (Swati Khandelwal/The Hacker News)
news.title_en: Researchers are paid $5K for reporting a bug to OpenAI that would let attackers run code in logged-in sessions of all who opened the hacker's ChatGPT share link (Swati Khandelwal/The Hacker News)
news.author: The Hacker News
news.content_snippet: A malicious ChatGPT share link could run an attacker's code in the logged-in session of anyone who opened it …
news.summary_en: Security researchers uncovered a critical remote code execution vulnerability embedded within ChatGPT's conversation share-link functionality. If a victim clicked a specially crafted malicious link, the flaw allowed attackers to execute code inside the victim's active, authenticated session. While the flaw posed severe account takeover risks, OpenAI patched the bug and paid the discoverers a mere $5,000 bounty, sparking widespread debate across the cybersecurity community.
news.title_zh: 打开分享链接即遭远程代码执行 修复高危漏洞仅悬赏五千

fact_bullets_zh: 【核心事件】安全研究团队与ChatGPT运营方OpenAI：特制分享链接可直接在受害者登录态中执行恶意代码，官方仅奖励5000美元
【起因与机理】功能设计未对共享上下文做好安全隔离，巨头赏金机制对高危漏洞定价过低
【关键数据与实测】OpenAI修复漏洞后仅支付5000美元赏金，引发技术圈对定价失衡的嘲讽。
【观点态度】攻击者可通过单一恶意链接静默劫持打开者的整个账户会话。
fact_bullets_en: [Core Event] Security researchers and OpenAI: Malicious share links allowed arbitrary code execution in active accounts; bounty paid was only $5K
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Inadequate input sanitization in shared contexts paired with stingy bug bounty valuation
[Key Metrics] OpenAI awarded only $5,000, triggering heavy criticism over its bounty policies.
[Perspective & Impact] Malicious links enabled silent hijacking of authenticated user sessions.

celebrity.title: The frustration with UVA football is real, but the core problem is larger than any player, coach or single individual. I
celebrity.title_en:
The frustration with UVA football is real, but the core problem is larger than any player, coach or single individual. In my view, it is a business problem.

Charlottesville (where one of our Good Feet stores resides) is one of the smallest TV markets in the country. Athletics today run on multi-year brand deals, NIL collectives, and revenue flywheels from large alumni bases and proximity to major corporate HQs. UVA lacks the geographical advantages and lacks the scale and reach of Ohio State, Michigan, Texas, or Florida. That is a structural constraint.

UVA’s football fan base is more fragile (not a fault of fans) due to a lack of a winning tradition compared to the power programs—Alabama, Texas, Oklahoma, Ohio State, Michigan, USC. Those are the Amazon, Walmarts and Coca-Colas of college football. They can operate on tradition and confidence that their customers will be back even when they miss. UVA cannot afford many misses and has to be scrappy: more creative, more personal, and more deliberate about every fan, donor, and sponsor. Otherwise the support of the fan base erodes quickly. The football program would make a strong Darden case study on building without the giants’ natural advantages.

In 2021 we were early NIL partners with UVA. We started with Kihei Clark on TV spots, then expanded to other athletes in UVA-logo jerseys, attaching millions in Good Feet advertising to the UVA brand. We followed the university’s approach: not pay-to-play, but real marketing leverage, inviting players to conferences, networking, and speaking opportunities. We did the same for others in football, men’s and women’s basketball, and non-rev sports. We are not a major Fortune 500 brand but we have made meaningful investments and will match our heart with anyone.

Two years ago major money flowed into UVA football. Problem solved, or so it seemed! Emphasis seemed to shift to seven and eight-figure checks. Those are wonderful gifts but that is not a sustainable model. Amazon, Coca-Cola, and Walmart, built flywheels one customer at a time.

Is it possible that those generous donations muddied good strategic thinking? It seems there is need of a strategy that attaches value at every level: the single fan with family at a few games, season-ticket holders and lower-level donors, small businesses attaching to the brand, larger sponsors, mid-tier five- and six-figure donors, and the premium seven-to-eight figure donors. celebrity.quote_zh:
弗吉尼亚大学足球队的挫败感是真实存在的，但核心问题比任何球员、教练或个人都更大。在我看来，这是一个商业问题。

夏洛茨维尔（我们的 Good Feet 商店之一就坐落于此）是美国最小的电视市场之一。如今的田径运动依赖于多年的品牌交易、NIL 集体以及来自大型校友基地和靠近主要公司总部的收入飞轮。 UVA 缺乏地理优势，也缺乏俄亥俄州、密歇根州、德克萨斯州或佛罗里达州的规模和覆盖范围。这是一个结构性限制。

与阿拉巴马州、德克萨斯州、俄克拉荷马州、俄亥俄州、密歇根州、南加州大学等实力项目相比，UVA 的橄榄球迷基础更加脆弱（不是球迷的错），因为缺乏获胜传统。这些是大学橄榄球界的亚马逊、沃尔玛和可口可乐。他们可以秉承传统经营，并相信即使顾客错过了，他们也会回来。 UVA 不能承受太多的失误，必须斗志昂扬：更有创意、更个性化、对每一位粉丝、捐助者和赞助商都更加深思熟虑。否则粉丝群的支持很快就会消失。足球项目将为达顿在没有巨人队天然优势的情况下进行建设提供强有力的案例研究。

2021 年，我们成为 UVA 的早期 NIL 合作伙伴。我们首先在电视广告中让基黑·克拉克 (Kihei Clark) 上场，然后扩展到穿着 UVA 徽标球衣的其他运动员，为 UVA 品牌投放了数百万美元的 Good Feet 广告。我们遵循了大学的方法：不是付费游戏，而是真正的营销杠杆，邀请玩家参加会议、社交和演讲机会。我们对足球、男子和女子篮球以及非职业体育运动中的其他人也做了同样的事情。我们不是财富 500 强的主要品牌，但我们进行了有意义的投资，并将与任何人心心相印。

两年前，大量资金流入弗吉尼亚大学橄榄球队。问题解决了，至少看起来是这样！重点似乎转向七位数和八位数的支票。这些都是很棒的礼物，但这不是一个可持续的模式。亚马逊、可口可乐和沃尔玛一次为一位客户制造飞轮。

这些慷慨的捐赠是否有可能混淆了良好的战略思维？似乎需要一种在各个层面赋予价值的策略：与家人一起观看几场比赛的单一球迷、季票持有者和较低级别的捐赠者、依附于品牌的小型企业、较大的赞助商、中型五位数和六位数的捐赠者以及高级七到八位数的捐赠者。当您以客户为中心时，您就要对这些客户负责。对上下级客户承担更大的责任是否有可能促进更好的足球战略？

传统与谦逊可以并存；传统和权利不能。卓越的学术成就和历史是优势，而不是足球强国的自动均衡器。对支付账单的人负责，做出艰难的战略决策，发挥创造力，倾听。拥抱成为大卫，因为你永远不会成为歌利亚。胜利将会到来。

celebrity.full_text_en:
LLMs accumulate a lot of declarative knowledge.
That's how they can answer a large number of questions. 
That's also why they require so many parameters and hence so much memory. 

But one can replace the accumulation of knowledge by *understanding*
That what JEPA world models do. 
That's one reason they can be useful with considerably less memory and training data  than LLMs. 

This paper merely shows that the underlying similarity structure of the data, whether text or image (e.g. co-occurence of words in text or objects in images) uniquely determines the shape of the representation point cloud, when the encoder is trained trained with a common anti-collapse criterion like SIGReg or VCReg (not by reconstruction).

this is f*cking insane. andrej karpathy: "the biggest regret of every engineer in my field right now is every AI conversation they never saved, and in 10 years the ones who started saving in 2024 will be running circles around the rest of us"

andrej karpathy, co-founder of openai, pulled 16M views on one idea: stop using AI to write code, use it to build a second brain that remembers every article, pdf, transcript and conversation you ever fed it

you point claude code at a folder, drop anything into it, and claude reads it, cross-links it with everything already there, and writes it into a living wiki. your knowledge finally compounds instead of leaking out of your head every friday

the stack:

→ brew install obsidian, mkdir ~/vault, cd ~/vault
→ run claude in that folder and type "init a knowledge vault with CLAUDE.md as the rules, /raw for sources, /wiki for your pages"
→ drop any file into /raw (youtube transcript, meeting notes, 400-page pdf, screenshot of a tweet) and type "ingest"
→ claude writes a wiki page, links it to 5 existing ones automatically, updates CLAUDE.md with any new pattern it noticed about how you think
→ never open a blank claude chat again. every question goes through the vault, every answer cites your own sources with dates and links

5 minutes to set up. compounding knowledge from that evening forward

the ugly part most will scroll past: in 10 years the engineers who started this in 2024 will remember every book, every podcast, every meeting with receipts. you will remember none of them. karpathy already picked which side he is on and you are still not on his

full step-by-step is in the article below

bookmark this before you waste another monday

openai 联合创始人 andrej karpathy 的一个想法获得了 1600 万次浏览：停止使用人工智能编写代码，用它来构建第二个大脑，记住你曾经喂给它的每一篇文章、pdf、文字记录和对话

你将 Claude Code 指向一个文件夹，将任何内容放入其中，然后克劳德读取它，将其与现有的所有内容交叉链接，然后将其写入动态 wiki。你的知识最终会复合，而不是每周五从你的脑子里漏出来

堆栈：

→brew 安装黑曜石，mkdir ~/vault，cd ~/vault
→ 在该文件夹中运行 claude 并输入“以 CLAUDE.md 作为规则初始化知识库，/raw 作为源，/wiki 作为您的页面”
→ 将任何文件放入 /raw（youtube 记录、会议记录、400 页 pdf、推文屏幕截图）并输入“摄取”
→ claude 编写一个 wiki 页面，自动将其链接到 5 个现有页面，使用它注意到的有关您的想法的任何新模式更新 CLAUDE.md
→ 永远不要再打开空白的克劳德聊天室。每个问题都会经过保险库，每个答案都会引用您自己的来源，并附上日期和链接

5 分钟即可设置。从那天晚上开始复合知识

丑陋的部分大多数人都会过去：在 2024 年开始这项工作的工程师们在 10 年内将记住每一本书、每个播客、每次带有收据的会议。你不会记得他们中的任何一个。卡帕西已经选择了他的立场，而你仍然不在他的立场

celebrity.full_text_en:
My vlog today was fully edited by Claude Code with Opus 5.5!

I copied the video clips from my DJI to a folder, then opened Claude Code in it and asked it to edit it into a 10 minute vlog

I made a few adjustments but not a lot

It transcribed everything I said with mlx-whisper (Whisper large-v3-turbo running on my MacBook Pro's GPU through Apple's MLX)

It pulled video frames every few seconds into grid images (contact sheets), so Claude could see what's in each clip

It used SpeechBrain ECAPA (a voice-matching model) to figure out what was my voice from other people

It then made thumbnails with OpenCV with YuNet's face detector

The edit itself is a list of cuts in a JSON file: which clip, start time, end time, Claude then picked the pieces by reading the transcripts and looking at the frame grids by itself

I added on screen captions for X and on YouTube for the first minute with Pillow (Python's image library)

P.S. I didn't ask for any of this, and I didn't know any of this until @thesamparr just asked me how I edited it

All I asked for was "Claude can you edit these clips into a 10 minute vlog for X and YouTube"

I think if I didn't have AI to edit it, I wouldn't be vlogging because editing would be such a painful and slow process for me and hiring someone to do it would be even more hassle for me!
celebrity.full_text_zh:
我今天的视频博客完全由 Claude Code 使用 Opus 5.5 编辑！

我将视频片段从 DJI 复制到一个文件夹，然后在其中打开 Claude Code 并要求它将其编辑成 10 分钟的视频博客

我做了一些调整，但调整不多

它转录了我用 mlx-whisper 所说的一切（Whisper large-v3-turbo 通过 Apple 的 MLX 在我的 MacBook Pro 的 GPU 上运行）

它每隔几秒钟将视频帧拉入网格图像（接触表），这样克劳德就可以看到每个剪辑中的内容

它使用 SpeechBrain ECAPA（一种语音匹配模型）来找出我从其他人那里听到的声音

然后使用 OpenCV 和 YuNet 的人脸检测器制作缩略图

编辑本身是 JSON 文件中的剪辑列表：哪个剪辑、开始时间、结束时间，然后 Claude 通过阅读脚本并自行查看帧网格来挑选片段

我使用 Pillow（Python 的图像库）在 X 的屏幕标题和 YouTube 上添加了第一分钟的标题

附：我没有要求任何这些，我也不知道这些，直到 @thesamparr 只是问我如何编辑它

我所要求的只是“克劳德，你能将这些剪辑编辑成 X 和 YouTube 的 10 分钟视频博客吗”

我想如果我没有人工智能来编辑它，我就不会做视频博客，因为编辑对我来说是一个痛苦而缓慢的过程，而且雇人来做这对我来说会更麻烦！

celebrity.full_text_en:
Weekend hack: HackerTube. I was annoyed with YouTube's recommendations so I had Claude filter down 43M comments over 20 years of HN to 6,454 videos that keep being recommended. *Significantly* better viewing experience, ~2 hours with Opus 5.5:
https://t.co/JIhXN7OSh1

- Excellent recs without any logins (state is kept in local browser session)
- Thumbnail is a representative frame from middle of the video instead of the super duper A/B test hyper-optimized user uploads
- Underlying data from the comment analysis as one zip file, point your Claude at it and ask for your own version
- HackerTube Longs ✊

A bit more on the process:
I use Claude Code (desktop app for Mac), Opus 5.5 on Medium effort as my default. I only talk to Claude and have it do everything, the only "manual work" I helped with in tandem was in the browser (reminiscent of MenuGen): 1) I had to create some kind of API key from Google Cloud UI to query YouTube for video metadata, 2) I booted up a VPS box for serving and 3) I bought the domain name. Once the box was up I gave Claude the IP and told it update, secure, harden, deploy and optimize the code, and it did the whole thing.

Many awesome projects that would have normally taken weeks/months even can now be few-shotted for breakfast. What else are we not thinking of.
celebrity.full_text_zh:
周末黑客：HackerTube。我对 YouTube 的推荐感到恼火，因此我让 Claude 将 HN 20 年来的 4300 万条评论过滤为 6,454 个不断推荐的视频。 *显着*更好的观看体验，Opus 5.5 约 2 小时：

- 无需任何登录即可获得出色的记录（状态保存在本地浏览器会话中）
- 缩略图是视频中间的代表性帧，而不是超级骗子 A/B 测试超优化的用户上传
- 来自评论分析的基础数据作为一个 zip 文件，将你的 Claude 指向它并询问你自己的版本
- HackerTube 长 ✊

更多关于该过程的信息：
我使用 Claude Code（Mac 桌面应用程序）、中等工作量的 Opus 5.5 作为我的默认设置。我只与 Claude 交谈并让它完成所有工作，我协同帮助的唯一“手动工作”是在浏览器中（让人想起 MenuGen）：1）我必须从 Google Cloud UI 创建某种 API 密钥来查询 YouTube 的视频元数据，2）我启动了一个 VPS 盒子进行服务，3）我购买了域名。盒子启动后，我给了 Claude IP，并告诉它更新、保护、强化、部署和优化代码，它完成了全部工作。

许多原本需要数周/数月才能完成的精彩项目现在甚至可以在早餐时就完成。还有什么是我们没有想到的。

celebrity.full_text_en:
🚨 PARASITE EVE II (1999) HAS BEEN PORTED NATIVELY TO PC — WITH 60 FPS, HIGHER RESOLUTIONS & MOD SUPPORT! 🧟🔥

One of the PlayStation's most beloved survival-horror RPGs is now PLAYABLE on Windows thanks to an incredible fan-made native PC port! 🎮

Developer Snaity (Adriano Teodoro) has brought Square's PS1 classic to modern PCs using the original game's decompiled C code, building upon the work of GabeRealB and contributors!

And this isn't conventional PlayStation emulation!

🔥 FEATURES:

✅ NATIVE WINDOWS PC PORT — NO PS1 EMULATOR REQUIRED!

The original PlayStation game code has been compiled for PC, with a custom runtime handling graphics, sound, controllers and other console functionality!

✅ HIGHER RESOLUTIONS — UP TO 8X THE ORIGINAL!

GPU-accelerated rendering with sub-pixel precision, perspective-correct textures and improved 3D image stability!

✅ SMOOTH 60 FPS PRESENTATION!

The original game logic continues running at 30 FPS, while interpolated frames deliver smoother 60 FPS visuals without adding input delay!

✅ MODERN CONTROLS!

Camera-relative analogue movement, remappable controls and modern gamepad support, alongside the original tank controls!

✅ ENHANCED VISUALS!

Bilinear texture filtering, bicubic background scaling, sharper HD text, optional CRT effects and integer scaling!

✅ EXPERIMENTAL MOD SUPPORT!

Replace backgrounds, textures, music, movies and game text! Translation support, cheats and asset extraction tools are also included!

🎮 BOTH DISCS PLAYABLE!

The port supports both discs, including cinematics, music, sound effects, saving and controller functionality.

💾 SAVE COMPATIBILITY!

Memory-card files can be transferred between the PC port and DuckStation!

🖥️ A GENUINE NATIVE PC PORT!

Unlike an emulator-based wrapper, PE2PC runs the game's decompiled code natively, with a custom Rust-based PC runtime replacing the PlayStation's hardware services.

⚠️ REQUIREMENTS:

💿 Your own USA PlayStation game dumps (SLUS-01042 and SLUS-01055), in CHD or CUE format.

💻 Windows 10/11 with Vulkan or OpenGL 3.3 support.

No copyrighted game data is included.

🛠️ CREDITS:

Developed by Snaity (Adriano Teodoro), building upon GabeRealB's Parasite Eve II decompilation.

🤖 AI DEVELOPMENT DISCLOSURE:

The developer openly credits Claude Code for writing much of the project's code, tools and documentation, with Snaity directing, reviewing and testing the work.

⭐ Please consider starring the GitHub repository to support development!

🎮 PROJECT & DOWNLOADS:

🔗https://t.co/7wxBuKKXxs

🌐 Discover more PC ports, recompilations and fan projects:

🔗https://t.co/9gMW2oj2lk

开发人员 Snaity（阿德里亚诺·特奥多罗）在 GabeRealB 和贡献者的工作基础上，使用原始游戏的反编译 C 代码，将 Square 的 PS1 经典游戏带入了现代 PC！

这不是传统的 PlayStation 模拟！

🔥 特点：

✅ 原生 WINDOWS PC 端口 — 无需 PS1 模拟器！

原始 PlayStation 游戏代码已针对 PC 进行编译，具有自定义运行时处理图形、声音、控制器和其他控制台功能！

✅ 更高的分辨率 — 高达原始分辨率的 8 倍！

GPU 加速渲染具有亚像素精度、透视校正纹理和改进的 3D 图像稳定性！

✅ 流畅的 60 FPS 演示！

原始游戏逻辑继续以 30 FPS 运行，而插值帧可提供更流畅的 60 FPS 视觉效果，而不会增加输入延迟！

✅ 现代控制！

与摄像机相关的模拟运动、可重新映射的控件和现代游戏手柄支持，以及原始的坦克控件！

✅ 增强视觉效果！

双线性纹理过滤、双三次背景缩放、更清晰的高清文本、可选的 CRT 效果和整数缩放！

✅ 实验性模组支持！

替换背景、纹理、音乐、电影和游戏文本！还包括翻译支持、作弊和资产提取工具！

🎮 两张光盘都可以播放！

该端口支持两种光盘，包括电影、音乐、音效、保存和控制器功能。

💾 保存兼容性！

存储卡文件可以在 PC 端口和 DuckStation 之间传输！

🖥️ 真正的原生 PC 端口！

prompts.takeaway_zh: 杜绝 AI 盲目重构全量文件、使用已弃用 API 或编造虚假第三方依赖包，强制执行防御性编程与自动化单测补全。
prompts.takeaway_en: Prevents AI from hallucinating npm packages, breaking documentation, or re-writing entire files. Enforces defensive coding and unit tests.
prompts.code_snippet:
# Cursor & Windsurf Project Rules (.cursorrules)

## 1. Documentation & Code Integrity
- Maintain documentation integrity: Never strip or alter unrelated existing docstrings and comments.
- Preserving context: When modifying a function, preserve surrounding logic and existing edge-case handlers.
- Targeted replacements: Always make minimal surgical edits instead of replacing entire file contents.

## 2. Dependency & API Safety
- Strictly forbid hallucinating npm/pip packages. Only import dependencies already declared in package.json / requirements.txt.
- Verify API signatures before calling external methods. Prefer standard library solutions where feasible.

## 3. Architecture & Type Safety
- Enforce strict TypeScript / Python typing. Avoid `any` types; prefer discriminated unions and explicit return types.
- Defensive coding: Always validate external inputs and handle potential null/undefined values gracefully.

## 4. Testing & Verification Gate
- Every new core feature or bugfix must be accompanied by corresponding unit tests.
- Never declare a task complete without executing lint checks and unit tests in terminal.

prompts.usage_guide_en: Copy and save the above rules into `.cursorrules` in your project root directory. Cursor & Windsurf will automatically enforce these guidelines during agent coding.

prompts.purpose_zh: 高转化竖屏短剧分镜与台词
prompts.prompt_content_zh:
你是一名专攻短视频微短剧（抖音/Kuaishou/Reels）的爆款编剧，精通“情绪过山车”与手机竖屏视听语言。

请根据以下设定创作一集 45~60 秒的短剧分镜剧本：
- 主角：{{主角身份}}
- 对手：{{反派身份}}
- 核心反转：{{核心反转}}

结构要求：
1. 【0-3秒冷开钩子】：第一帧必须有视觉颠覆或动作冲突（{{第1秒颠覆钩子}}），直接打破常规，禁止废话铺垫；
2. 【4-25秒情绪积压】：正反打对峙台词（Shot-Reverse-Shot），将观众被压抑的情绪推向临界点；
3. 【26-40秒逆转打脸】：主角亮出关键底牌或反杀动作，情绪瞬间宣泄；
4. 【40-50秒卡点断章】：以特写镜头加悬念台词戛然而止，促使用户立即滑向下一集。

输出格式必须包含：镜头号、景别（特写/中景/全景）、机位运动、画面描写、对白与音效提示。
prompts.prompt_content_en: You are a professional micro-drama screenwriter. Generate a 45-60 second vertical drama screenplay following the viral 3-second hook, shot-reverse-shot tension build, emotional turnaround, and cliffhanger ending formula.

sample_output.title: 实战剧本样章：《辞职信上的签名》
sample_output.content:
【第1镜 | 特写 | 俯冲急推】
画面：一只指节发白的手将一叠文件狠狠拍在红木总裁办公桌上，咖啡杯被震倒，黑褐液体飞溅。
音效：沉闷震耳的巨响【DUANG】。
主角（冷冽）："林总，这份千万项目的承揽协议，我拒绝签字。"

【第2镜 | 正打·中景 | 仰角机位】
画面：大腹便便的林总冷笑点燃雪茄，烟雾缭绕中居高临下。
林总："拒绝？苏澈，你不过是我公司养的一条狗，没有我的印章，你在整个行业休想拿到一分钱融资！"

【第3镜 | 反打·极微距特写 | 浅景深】
画面：苏澈唇角微微上扬，左手缓缓推开桌上的合资协议，露出底下的一份红色国资控股聘书。
苏澈："林总，您好像忘了看抬头。今天上午九点，集团总公司已经完成了对你的全资收购——现在，我是你的直接合规清算人。"

【第4镜 | 全景 | 快速拉远 + 卡点悬念】
画面：林总雪茄直接掉在西裤上，脸色煞白，门外两名身穿制服的法务推门而入。
音效：尖锐的心跳悬疑停顿音【BGM骤停】。
字幕：【下集看点：隐藏五年的顶级操盘手真实身份曝光！】

prompts.prompt_content_zh:
你是一名麦肯锡级别的高级商业数据分析师，精通结构化因果归因与杜邦拆解分析。

针对我提供的 {{业务指标}} 数据，其近期出现 {{异常表现}}，请按以下框架深度剖析：
1. 【指标公式拆解】：将该指标拆分为 3~4 个下级核心因子（如转化率、客单价、复购周期），指出哪个因子波动贡献率最大；
2. 【多维下钻 (Drill-down)】：从 {{维度拆解}}（如渠道、地域、品类、新老客）分析异常聚集点；
3. 【可执行建议】：摒弃假大空的套话，给出接下来 48 小时内的 3 个立竿见影的动作与 1 个监控预警公式。
prompts.prompt_content_en: You are a senior business intelligence analyst. Dissect the metric anomaly into component drivers, perform multi-dimensional drill-down, and deliver prioritized, actionable remediation steps.

【杜邦拆解贡献率分析】：
1. 渠道维度：自然搜索量稳定（波动 <2%），但付费投流渠道跳出率贡献了 72% 的下跌额度；
2. 终端维度：移动端 iOS 表现正常，Android Web 呈现断崖式报错，核心原因是新版本结账 SDK 在低内存机型发生闪退。

【48小时纠偏行动】：
- 动作1 (技术)：立即灰度回滚 Android 渠道结账前端包至 v2.4.1；
- 动作2 (运营)：向受影响但未支付成功的 1,420 位加购用户推送 5 元免门槛补偿券唤醒；

prompts.code_snippet:
# Modelfile: Optimized DeepSeek-R1 Deployment
FROM deepseek-r1:14b-qwen-distill-q4_K_M

# 1. 显存与上下文窗口优化：分配 16k 上下文并开启 KV Cache 压缩
PARAMETER num_ctx 16384
PARAMETER num_predict 4096

# 2. 避免思维链自旋死循环的核心解码超参
PARAMETER temperature 0.6
PARAMETER top_p 0.95
PARAMETER repeat_penalty 1.15

# 3. 强力系统提示词：约束必须直接在 <think> 标签内进行深度反思，结束立刻给出最终结果
SYSTEM """
You are an expert autonomous reasoning AI. Think carefully through the problem step by step inside <think>...</think> tags.
Once reasoning is complete, provide the concise, direct, and actionable answer immediately without repeating reasoning steps.
"""

prompts.usage_guide_en: Save as Modelfile, then run 'ollama create deepseek-r1-opt -f Modelfile'. Delivers stable reasoning with low VRAM footprint and no loop loops.
prompts.summary_zh: 解决消费级显卡（RTX 4060/4090/Mac M系列）部署 DeepSeek-R1 时显存溢出（OOM）与思维链无限复读问题的精调 Modelfile 参数配置。
prompts.summary_en: Optimized Ollama Modelfile for running DeepSeek-R1 on consumer GPUs (RTX 4090/Mac M-series) without OOM or infinite reasoning loops.
prompts.prompt_content_zh:
# Modelfile: Optimized DeepSeek-R1 Deployment
FROM deepseek-r1:14b-qwen-distill-q4_K_M

# 1. 显存与上下文窗口优化：分配 16k 上下文并开启 KV Cache 压缩
PARAMETER num_ctx 16384
PARAMETER num_predict 4096

# 2. 避免思维链自旋死循环的核心解码超参
PARAMETER temperature 0.6
PARAMETER top_p 0.95
PARAMETER repeat_penalty 1.15

# 3. 强力系统提示词：约束必须直接在 <think> 标签内进行深度反思，结束立刻给出最终结果
SYSTEM """
You are an expert autonomous reasoning AI. Think carefully through the problem step by step inside <think>...</think> tags.
Once reasoning is complete, provide the concise, direct, and actionable answer immediately without repeating reasoning steps.
"""
prompts.prompt_content_en:
# Modelfile: Optimized DeepSeek-R1 Deployment
FROM deepseek-r1:14b-qwen-distill-q4_K_M

# 1. Video memory and context window optimization: allocate 16k context and enable KV Cache compression
PARAMETER num_ctx 16384
PARAMETER num_predict 4096

# 2. Core decoding hyperparameters to avoid the endless spin loop of the thinking chain
PARAMETER temperature 0.6
PARAMETER top_p 0.95
PARAMETER repeat_penalty 1.15

# 3. Powerful system prompt word: Constraints must be reflected directly in the <think> tag, and the final result will be given immediately after the end.
SYSTEM """
You are an expert autonomous reasoning AI. Think carefully through the problem step by step inside <think>...</think> tags.
Once reasoning is complete, provide the concise, direct, and actionable answer immediately without repeating reasoning steps.
"""

viral_posts.title_en:
Remove your main @github account from your computer. Now.

Give your AI agent a separate GitHub account with minimal permissions per repo.

Let the agent create PRs, then use your main account to review and merge them.

Obvious advice, but essential in the age of AI agents.
viral_posts.title_zh:
从计算机中删除您的主 @github 帐户。现在。

为您的 AI 代理提供一个单独的 GitHub 帐户，每个存储库具有最小的权限。

让代理创建 PR，然后使用您的主帐户来审查和合并它们。

显而易见的建议，但在人工智能代理时代至关重要

viral_posts.title: The frustration with UVA football is real, but the core problem is larger than any player, coach or single individual. I
viral_posts.title_en:
The frustration with UVA football is real, but the core problem is larger than any player, coach or single individual. In my view, it is a business problem.

Charlottesville (where one of our Good Feet stores resides) is one of the smallest TV markets in the country. Athletics today run on multi-year brand deals, NIL collectives, and revenue flywheels from large alumni bases and proximity to major corporate HQs. UVA lacks the geographical advantages and lacks the scale and reach of Ohio State, Michigan, Texas, or Florida. That is a structural constraint.

UVA’s football fan base is more fragile (not a fault of fans) due to a lack of a winning tradition compared to the power programs—Alabama, Texas, Oklahoma, Ohio State, Michigan, USC. Those are the Amazon, Walmarts and Coca-Colas of college football. They can operate on tradition and confidence that their customers will be back even when they miss. UVA cannot afford many misses and has to be scrappy: more creative, more personal, and more deliberate about every fan, donor, and sponsor. Otherwise the support of the fan base erodes quickly. The football program would make a strong Darden case study on building without the giants’ natural advantages.

In 2021 we were early NIL partners with UVA. We started with Kihei Clark on TV spots, then expanded to other athletes in UVA-logo jerseys, attaching millions in Good Feet advertising to the UVA brand. We followed the university’s approach: not pay-to-play, but real marketing leverage, inviting players to conferences, networking, and speaking opportunities. We did the same for others in football, men’s and women’s basketball, and non-rev sports. We are not a major Fortune 500 brand but we have made meaningful investments and will match our heart with anyone.

Two years ago major money flowed into UVA football. Problem solved, or so it seemed! Emphasis seemed to shift to seven and eight-figure checks. Those are wonderful gifts but that is not a sustainable model. Amazon, Coca-Cola, and Walmart, built flywheels one customer at a time.

Is it possible that those generous donations muddied good strategic thinking? It seems there is need of a strategy that attaches value at every level: the single fan with family at a few games, season-ticket holders and lower-level donors, small businesses attaching to the brand, larger sponsors, mid-tier five- and six-figure donors, and the premium seven-to-eight figure donors. When you are customer focused, you are accountable to those customers. Is it possible, that greater accountability to customers up and down the ladder, could foster better football strategy?

Tradition and humility can go together; tradition and entitlement cannot. Academic excellence and history are strengths, not automatic equalizers to the football powers. Be accountable to the people paying the bills, make hard, strategic decisions, be creative, listen. Embrace being David because you will never be Goliath. Winning will come.

viral_posts.quote_zh:
弗吉尼亚大学足球队的挫败感是真实存在的，但核心问题比任何球员、教练或个人都更大。在我看来，这是一个商业问题。

夏洛茨维尔（我们的 Good Feet 商店之一就坐落于此）是美国最小的电视市场之一。如今的田径运动依赖于多年的品牌交易、NIL 集体以及来自大型校友基地和靠近主要公司总部的收入飞轮。 UVA 缺乏地理优势，也缺乏俄亥俄州、密歇根州、德克萨斯州或佛罗里达州的规模和覆盖范围。这是一个结构性限制。

与阿拉巴马州、德克萨斯州、俄克拉荷马州、俄亥俄州、密歇根州、南加州大学等实力项目相比，UVA 的橄榄球迷基础更加脆弱（不是球迷的错），因为缺乏获胜传统。这些是大学橄榄球界的亚马逊、沃尔玛和可口可乐。他们可以秉承传统经营，并相信即使顾客错过了，他们也会回来。 UVA 不能承受太多的失误，必须斗志昂扬：更有创意、更个性化、对每一位粉丝、捐助者和赞助商都更加深思熟虑。否则粉丝群的支持很快就会消失。足球项目将为达顿在没有巨人队天然优势的情况下进行建设提供强有力的案例研究。

2021 年，我们成为 UVA 的早期 NIL 合作伙伴。我们首先在电视广告中让基黑·克拉克 (Kihei Clark) 上场，然后扩展到穿着 UVA 徽标球衣的其他运动员，为 UVA 品牌投放了数百万美元的 Good Feet 广告。我们遵循了大学的方法：不是付费游戏，而是真正的营销杠杆，邀请玩家参加会议、社交和演讲机会。我们对足球、男子和女子篮球以及非职业体育运动中的其他人也做了同样的事情。我们不是财富 500 强的主要品牌，但我们进行了有意义的投资，并将与任何人心心相印。

两年前，大量资金流入弗吉尼亚大学橄榄球队。问题解决了，至少看起来是这样！重点似乎转向七位数和八位数的支票。这些都是很棒的礼物，但这不是一个可持续的模式。亚马逊、可口可乐和沃尔玛一次为一位客户制造飞轮。

这些慷慨的捐赠是否有可能混淆了良好的战略思维？似乎需要一种在各个层面赋予价值的策略：与家人一起观看几场比赛的单一球迷、季票持有者和较低级别的捐赠者、依附于品牌的小型企业、较大的赞助商、中型五位数和六位数的捐赠者以及高级七到八位数的捐赠者。当您以客户为中心时，您就要对这些客户负责。对上下级客户承担更大的责任是否有可能促进更好的足球战略？

传统与谦逊可以并存；传统和权利不能。卓越的学术成就和历史是优势，而不是足球强国的自动均衡器。对支付账单的人负责，做出艰难的战略决策，发挥创造力，倾听。拥抱成为大卫，因为你永远不会成为歌利亚。胜利将会到来。

Those are the Amazon, Walmarts and Coca-Colas of college football. They can operate on tradition and confidence that their customers will be back even when they miss. UVA cannot afford many misses and has to be scrappy: more creative, more personal, and more deliberate about every fan, donor, and sponsor. Otherwise the support of the fan base erodes quickly. The football program would make a strong Darden case study on building without the giants’ natural advantages.

In 2021 we were early NIL partners with UVA. We started with Kihei Clark on TV spots, then expanded to other athletes in UVA-logo jerseys, attaching millions in Good Feet advertising to the UVA brand. We followed the university’s approach: not pay-to-play, but real marketing leverage, inviting players to conferences, networking, and speaking opportunities. We did the same for others in football, men’s and women’s basketball, and non-rev sports. We are not a major Fortune 500 brand but we have made meaningful investments and will match our heart with anyone.

Two years ago major money flowed into UVA football. Problem solved, or so it seemed! Emphasis seemed to shift to seven and eight-figure checks. Those are wonderful gifts but that is not a sustainable model. Amazon, Coca-Cola, and Walmart, built flywheels one customer at a time.

Is it possible that those generous donations muddied good strategic thinking? It seems there is need of a strategy that attaches value at every level: the single fan with family at a few games, season-ticket holders and lower-level donors, small businesses attaching to the brand, larger sponsors, mid-tier five- and six-figure donors, and the premium seven-to-eight figure donors. When you are customer focused, you are accountable to those customers. Is it possible, that greater accountability to customers up and down the ladder, could foster better football strategy?

Tradition and humility can go together; tradition and entitlement cannot. Academic excellence and history are strengths, not automatic equalizers to the football powers. Be accountable to the people paying the bills, make hard, strategic decisions, be creative, listen. Embrace being David because you will never be Goliath. Winning will come.

集体以及来自大型校友基地和靠近主要公司总部的收入飞轮。 UVA 缺乏地理优势，也缺乏俄亥俄州、密歇根州、德克萨斯州或佛罗里达州的规模和覆盖范围。这是一个结构性限制。

与阿拉巴马州、德克萨斯州、俄克拉荷马州、俄亥俄州、密歇根州、南加州大学等实力项目相比，UVA 的橄榄球迷基础更加脆弱（不是球迷的错），因为缺乏获胜传统。这些是大学橄榄球界的亚马逊、沃尔玛和可口可乐。他们可以秉承传统经营，并相信即使顾客错过了，他们也会回来。 UVA 不能承受太多的失误，必须斗志昂扬：更有创意、更个性化、对每一位粉丝、捐助者和赞助商都更加深思熟虑。否则粉丝群的支持很快就会消失。足球项目将为达顿在没有巨人队天然优势的情况下进行建设提供强有力的案例研究。

2021 年，我们成为 UVA 的早期 NIL 合作伙伴。我们首先在电视广告中让基黑·克拉克 (Kihei Clark) 上场，然后扩展到穿着 UVA 徽标球衣的其他运动员，为 UVA 品牌投放了数百万美元的 Good Feet 广告。我们遵循了大学的方法：不是付费游戏，而是真正的营销杠杆，邀请玩家参加会议、社交和演讲机会。我们对足球、男子和女子篮球以及非职业体育运动中的其他人也做了同样的事情。我们不是财富 500 强的主要品牌，但我们进行了有意义的投资，并将与任何人心心相印。

两年前，大量资金流入弗吉尼亚大学橄榄球队。问题解决了，至少看起来是这样！重点似乎转向七位数和八位数的支票。这些都是很棒的礼物，但这不是一个可持续的模式。亚马逊、可口可乐和沃尔玛一次为一位客户制造飞轮。

这些慷慨的捐赠是否有可能混淆了良好的战略思维？似乎需要一种在各个层面赋予价值的策略：与家人一起观看几场比赛的单一球迷、季票持有者和较低级别的捐赠者、依附于品牌的小型企业、较大的赞助商、中型五位数和六位数的捐赠者以及高级七到八位数的捐赠者。当您以客户为中心时，您就要对这些客户负责。对上下级客户承担更大的责任是否有可能促进更好的足球战略？

传统与谦逊可以并存；传统和权利不能。卓越的学术成就和历史是优势，而不是足球强国的自动均衡器。对支付账单的人负责，做出艰难的战略决策，发挥创造力，倾听。拥抱成为大卫，因为你永远不会成为歌利亚。胜利将会到来。
